definitions.explanation: The entirety or full amount of something, expressed using the traditional Japanese system of tenths.

examples.japanese: {十割|じゅうわり}そば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十割|じゅうわり}⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦やり{遂|と}げた→やり遂げる：16745_yaritogeru⟧。
examples.english: I accomplished this work entirely through my own efforts.

examples.japanese: {十割|じゅうわり}そば⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一切|いっさい}→一切：06662_issai⟧⟦{使|つか}わ→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ず、⟦そば{粉|こ}→そば粉：27277_sobako⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{風味|ふうみ}→風味：14622_fuumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れ→切れる：01936_kireru⟧やすい。
examples.english: 100% buckwheat soba uses no wheat flour at all and is made only with buckwheat flour, so it has a rich flavor but breaks easily.

notes:
In the traditional Japanese counting system, amounts are measured in ⟦{割|わり}→割：03194_wari⟧ (tenths). {十割|じゅうわり} means ten-tenths, i.e., 100 percent. This system is widely used in baseball batting averages, alcohol content, and food composition.

The most well-known usage is {十割|じゅうわり}そば, soba noodles made entirely from buckwheat flour with no wheat flour mixed in. Standard soba is typically {八割|はちわり} (80% buckwheat) or {二八|にはち}そば.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十割|じゅうわり}そば: 100% buckwheat soba
- {十割|じゅうわり}⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧: full cost burden (paying 100%)
- {十割|じゅうわり}⟦{給付|きゅうふ}→給付：13848_kyuufu⟧: full benefit payment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧: 100 percent — the Western-style equivalent, more versatile in usage
- {八割|はちわり}: 80 percent — commonly used for standard soba composition
- ⟦{全額|ぜんがく}→全額：16829_zengaku⟧: the full amount — used specifically for money
